content: Denizhan Kara is a Machine Learning Engineer at Waymo and holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. His work spans multimodal and time-series foundation models, robust and data-efficient representation learning, autonomous driving, and distributed sensing.
summary: Machine Learning Engineer at Waymo and UIUC Computer Science Ph.D. working on multimodal and time-series foundation models, robust representation learning, and autonomous systems.
title: Denizhan Kara
